text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Aren't you overdoing it a bit?

text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? If anything,
I'm not
doing enough!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I need to eat and train just like the best
runners
do.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
If I do that, my body will be the same as
theirs!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(But why the heck does every
Umamusume have a
black hole for a
stomach?!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(My weight's gone through the roof just
trying to
eat as much as them.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
(Dang it! I'm gonna burn it off through
training! I
won't stop till it's all gone!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин throws herself into
strength
training and manages her
weight successfully.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
